from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
A = 0x77
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x1e')
time.sleep_ms(3)
prom = []
for i in range(8):
    i2c.writeto(A, bytes([0xA0 + 2 * i]))
    b = i2c.readfrom(A, 2)
    prom.append(b[0] << 8 | b[1])
def crc4(p):
    p = list(p)
    p[7] &= 0xFF00
    r = 0
    for c in range(16):
        r ^= (p[c >> 1] & 0xFF) if c % 2 else (p[c >> 1] >> 8)
        for _ in range(8):
            r = ((r << 1) ^ 0x3000) & 0xFFFF if r & 0x8000 else (r << 1) & 0xFFFF
    return (r >> 12) & 0xF
print('CRC ok' if crc4(prom) == prom[7] & 0xF else 'CRC bad')
C = prom
def adc(cmd):
    i2c.writeto(A, bytes([cmd]))
    time.sleep_ms(10)
    i2c.writeto(A, b'\x00')
    b = i2c.readfrom(A, 3)
    return b[0] << 16 | b[1] << 8 | b[2]
while True:
    D1 = adc(0x48)
    D2 = adc(0x58)
    dT = D2 - C[5] * 256
    TEMP = 2000 + dT * C[6] // 8388608
    OFF = C[2] * 65536 + C[4] * dT // 128
    SENS = C[1] * 32768 + C[3] * dT // 256
    if TEMP < 2000:
        T2 = dT * dT // 2147483648
        OFF2 = 5 * (TEMP - 2000) ** 2 // 2
        SENS2 = 5 * (TEMP - 2000) ** 2 // 4
        if TEMP < -1500:
            OFF2 += 7 * (TEMP + 1500) ** 2
            SENS2 += 11 * (TEMP + 1500) ** 2 // 2
        TEMP -= T2
        OFF -= OFF2
        SENS -= SENS2
    P = (D1 * SENS // 2097152 - OFF) // 32768
    print('P=%.1f T=%.1f' % (P / 100, TEMP / 100))
    time.sleep_ms(500)
